name: notepadia-monorepo
description: Notepadia - a Notepad++-style desktop text editor built on Eclipse Theia

scripts.package:win: yarn --cwd applications/electron clean:dist && yarn build:extensions && yarn --cwd applications/electron build:prod && npx --no-install electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:linux: yarn --cwd applications/electron clean:dist && yarn build:extensions && yarn --cwd applications/electron build:prod && npx --no-install electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.package:mac: yarn --cwd applications/electron clean:dist && yarn build:extensions && yarn --cwd applications/electron build:prod && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false npx --no-install electron-builder --mac --publish never
